gaps: Requires new quantity meanings for pooled emission/output roles and pooled intensity; units kg and unit exist. Ratio-of-sums is engine-supported once meanings exist.

models.inverse_notes: Family-model forward evaluation only: inverse views of family models are not supported. Forward substitution replays each case (18000/140000; 10000/1250000). Site-level inversion needs single-site records, not this pooled ratio.
limitations: A pooled ratio hides site heterogeneity; it must be reported with site count, coverage and the unpooled range.
Denominator must be strictly positive in total; an all-zero output ledger is rejected by failed evaluation, not by a guard.

assumptions: Source assumption: EPA 2018 ledger (292.4M short tons, weight basis, post-consumer MSW scope) with the July-2018 resident population derived as 328.2M/1.005 from the Census July-2019 release (rounded inputs); mid-year population versus calendar-year generation mismatch is disclosed.
Application profile: annual per-capita rate in ledger tons per person; daily or per-pound displays (x2000/365 for short tons) stay outside the canonical expression.

gaps: Requires new quantity meanings: waste_total_mass (shared), resident_population, per-capita generation; new unit t/person. Scalar quotient fits the engine once meanings/units exist.

models.inverse_notes: Gpc with positive P determines Mt = Gpc x P; Gpc with positive Mt determines P = Mt / Gpc. P = 0 excluded (undefined); Gpc = 0 with positive P implies zero generation. Substitution checks: 0.8953747715 x 326567164 ~= 292400000 recovers case national-2018; 292400000 / 0.8953747715 ~= 326567164 recovers P. Algebraic only; population choice (resident, mid-year) conditions the result.
limitations: Mid-year resident population is an approximation for calendar-year generation; tourism, undercount and scope differences are not corrected here.
Rounded inputs (292.4M; 328.2M and 0.5%) propagate to about two parts per thousand; the tolerance reflects that, not instrument precision.

references.method: EPA 2018 total 292.4M short tons with July-2018 population derived from Census (328.2M July 2019 / 1.005); quotient independently computed. Cross-check: x2000/365 = 4.906 lb/person/day, matching EPA's published 4.9.
references.provenance: Total from published EPA figure; population derived from published Census estimates; quotient independently computed.

references.method: EPA 2018 paper/paperboard generation 67.4M short tons over the same derived population; materially different numerator from case national-2018.
references.provenance: Generation from published EPA figure; population derived as above; quotient independently computed.
